name: vale-agent
description: Vale Agent — Windows device MCP server (terminal/SSH/serial) + panel. Self-hosted npm distribution.
//build: 唯一构建路径：在本目录执行 npm run build。它是自包含的：经 npm exec 按需拉取 typescript@5，无需预装任何 node_modules（干净检出可跑；旧脚本引用 ../vale-desktop-electron/node_modules/.bin/tsc，干净检出必 ENOENT）。必须用 npm exec --package … -- tsc 的形式：npx 会吃掉传给 tsc 的 -p/--outDir 等参数（round-435：npx 写法从未真正跑通过）。先编 electron TS（--noCheck 纯 emit，与 release.yml 一致）同步两处 src/*.js，再编 src/vale.ts 到 bin/vale.js 并校验 round-298 标记（弱 oracle，只证某次构建发生，新鲜性由 publish-release.sh 的 tsc 重编 + cmp 门保证）。

scripts.build: npm exec --yes --package typescript@5 -- tsc -p ../vale-desktop-electron/tsconfig.json --outDir /tmp/vale-electron-fresh --noCheck && cp /tmp/vale-electron-fresh/main.js ../vale-desktop-electron/src/main.js && cp /tmp/vale-electron-fresh/preload.js ../vale-desktop-electron/src/preload.js && cp /tmp/vale-electron-fresh/url-policy.js ../vale-desktop-electron/src/url-policy.js && cp ../vale-desktop-electron/src/main.js ../vale-desktop-electron/src/preload.js ../vale-desktop-electron/src/url-policy.js ./vale-desktop-electron/src/ && npm exec --yes --package typescript@5 -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir /tmp/vale-fresh-bin && cp /tmp/vale-fresh-bin/vale.js bin/vale.js && grep -q "vale-release" bin/vale.js && rm -rf /tmp/vale-electron-fresh /tmp/vale-fresh-bin
